train_seed_rule: learner_seed +100000*(generation+1); all four candidates in one generation share this worker seed
admission: At least one terrain has independent fixed-code confirmation;101 passes,107 does not. Terrain107 remains exploratory, no prior successful code imported.
learning: EpisodeSearch v1: zero mean/std.3, bounded[-1,1], first batch containszero, four candidates per batch, complete episode elites2, mean/std update with floor.1; all outcomes and costs retained. No neural optimizer steps in frozen child workers.
final_rule: Freeze final generation mean before evaluation. No best-epoch or best-seen-code selection. No old replay/checkpoint/code imported.
evaluation: Each terrain/seed: candidate5x2000 and base5x2000 paired task starts; candidate/base each2x1000 flat. Worker seed equals learner seed, distinct from all training batch seeds. Candidate thenbase on101; base thencandidate on107 after training.
second_seed_gate: Only after first-seed complete audit: candidate>=4/5 on each terrain, all flat retention passes, no task safety violations, at least one terrain gains>=.2 vs base, other loses<=.2. Otherwise do not run seed149 for this configuration.
stable_rule: If both independent learning seeds run: each terrain>=9/10 and each session>=4/5; repeated positive gain as G1 rule; flat retention and safety pass. Still needs new-development-terrain and gait evidence for full goal.
retention_rule: Prior locked rule: full windows,750steady samples,no fall/reset/safety violation; meanXY<=max(1.1*base,base+.005), eachX/Y<=base+.01m/s.
failure_policy: No replacement starts or failed-stage retry; infrastructure/numerical failure stops affected session without final promotion. Interrupted outcomes retained and excluded from elites. Source bound; no midrun runtime edits.
cost_classification: Child evaluation phases during search are training costs in outer manifest, not heldout evaluation. Unused positive child retention placeholders cannot be spent. 5*4*2000 train +2*5*2000 task +2*2*1000 flat=64000 per terrain/seed.
limits: Learning2D fixed joint synergy parameters, not a phase-conditioned gait learner. No broadened action bounds, teacher, extra sensing or sealed terrain.
